redundancy_check.note: All final units were cross-checked for duplicate evaluation targets. Each unit addresses distinct material facts: financial performance (K1), structural changes (K2), major contracts (K3), operational milestones (K4), strategic investment (K5), market positioning (K6), liquidity position (K7), and critical post-period events (K8). No unit evaluates the same content as another.

key_information_units.information: Headline financial performance showing net sales decreased to SEK 295M (from SEK 352M in 2024) with EBITDA of SEK 17M (third consecutive positive year but down from SEK 47M), EBIT loss of SEK 40M (compared to SEK 4M loss in 2024), and operating cash flow turning negative at SEK -73M (from SEK 57M in 2024), while cash reserves declined to SEK 30M.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial highlights table (page 5), Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income (page 33), Consolidated Balance Sheet (page 34), Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows (page 36)

key_information_units.information: Business restructuring into two segments (Products & Missions and Data & Services) to enhance operational efficiency, with Data & Services segment growing net sales by approximately 80% to SEK 80M (from SEK 45M in 2024) driven by recurring maritime data revenues from operational Sedna satellites.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Operations section (page 9-11), CEO Review (page 6), Business segments highlights (page 11)

key_information_units.information: Major contract acquisitions including ESA's INFLECION Phase 1 agreement (part of a SEK 350M co-funded program with 50% UK Space Agency contribution) and SEK 11.8M order for EPS-Sterna weather constellation components, significantly boosting order backlog and providing multi-year revenue visibility.
key_information_units.source_evidence: 2025 in brief (page 5), Board of Directors' Report (page 32), Significant events during the year (page 32)

key_information_units.information: Key operational milestones: Sedna-1 and Sedna-2 satellites became fully operational strengthening maritime AIS network capacity; first CubeCAT laser communication terminals delivered enabling high-speed optical links; assembly commenced on first two VIREON™ Earth Observation satellites for 2026 launch.
key_information_units.source_evidence: 2025 in brief (page 5), Weather technology praised by ESA section (page 5), Operations structured in two segments (page 5), Board of Directors' Report (page 32)

key_information_units.information: Strategic institutional investment by Bonnier Capital of up to SEK 140M (with SEK 50.3M initial tranche completed in December 2025) strengthening ownership base and securing funding for satellite constellation development and data services expansion.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Institutional ownership strengthened section (page 5), Board of Directors' Report (page 32), Top 10 shareholders table (page 18)

key_information_units.information: Market positioning leveraged through AI-enhanced space-based data services and vertical integration in satellite manufacturing, with focus shifting toward recurring revenue streams from operational constellations rather than project-based hardware sales.
key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO Review (page 6), Invest in AAC Clyde Space section (page 8), Business model description (page 9-10)

key_information_units.information: Liquidity management via expanded overdraft facility to SEK 50M (from SEK 30M) and maintained equity ratio of 80% (up from 71% in 2024), ensuring financial stability despite cash flow pressures from program delays and investment requirements.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Cash flow, liquidity and financial position section (page 33), Consolidated Balance Sheet (page 34), Significant events during the year (page 32)

key_information_units.information: Material post-reporting-period events: successful launch and commissioning of VIREON™-1 and VIREON™-2 Earth Observation satellites; initiation of Sedna-3 and Sedna-4 maritime satellite construction; receipt of EUR 76.3M order from OHB Sweden for 20 EPS-Sterna microwave radiometers.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Significant events after the end of the year (page 32, 36), Board of Directors' Report (page 32)
